verdict.rationale: The axis applies because AMD's Instinct ecosystem documents Spur, a Slurm-compatible AI-native job scheduler. That evidence covers GPU-first resource and queue scheduling of jobs, not recurring or timed schedules (cron-style workflows), so it is adjacent and earns no credit for this story. missing for 10: any documented recurring or cron-style job scheduling, workflow scheduling definitions, and hands-on corroboration of either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Spur AI-native job scheduler, drop-in compatible with Slurm, with GPU-first scheduling and Raft-based state.
